 Dated this the 8th day of February, 2017.
 J U D G M E N T

It is seen that pursuant to the direction issued in the writ petition, the petitioner has been issued Ext.R1(f) communication stating that he has not taken all the remedial measures for compliance with the provisions contained in the Food Safety and Standards Act for holding a licence for packaging edible oils.
Ext.R1(f) communication is seen issued based on Ext.R1(d) report.
In the circumstances, the contempt case is closed without prejudice to the right of the petitioner to challenge Ext.R1(f) communication and Ext.R1(d) report.
